question: How are seeing and sprinkling distinguished?
premises: seen and looked upon by rays-kindled eye-offering
inference: Seeing is ocular offering; sprinkling is drop-moistening — distinct acts.
uncertainties: drsto/avalokita pair kept as two seeings
plain_english: Seen and looked upon indeed, by rays-kindled eye-offering — sprinkled only, moistened by argha-vessel drops.
